headline: Congress hits pause with both chambers gaveling down to skeleton crews as they recess into next week.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Thursday, October 1, conducting only routine business before adjourning for the recess period. No substantive legislative action took place.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Thursday, October 1, for a pro forma session lasting just three minutes. Eighty new bills and 17 resolutions were introduced, and a report on veteran traumatic brain injury research grants was filed, but no floor votes occurred.

committees.topic: Nominations hearing for Assistant Secretaries and Export-Import Bank officials
